propositions.name: light_velocity_unaffected_by_plate_motion
propositions.statement: The velocity of light between two steel plates moving together is not increased or diminished by their motion.
propositions.quote: The velocity of light between two steel plates moving together in their own plane, an inch apart, is not increased or diminished by so much as

propositions.name: no_first_order_effect_irrotational_motion
propositions.statement: No first-order effect of purely irrotational etherial motion can ever be optically detected.
propositions.quote: no first-order effect of purely irrotational etherial motion can ever be optically detected

propositions.name: single_valued_potential_implies_ray_independence
propositions.statement: When the motion of a medium is characterised everywhere by a single-valued potential function, the course of observable rays through it is independent of the motion.
propositions.quote: as long as the motion of a medium is characterised everywhere by a single-valued potential function, the course of all observable rays through it

propositions.name: travel_time_independent_of_motion_except_second_order
propositions.statement: The time of journey along a given path through a material is independent of the motion, except for the second order of aberration-magnitude.
propositions.quote: the time of journey along any given path through any kind of material is likewise perfectly definite, and independent of the motion, except for experiments directed to the second order of aberration-magnitude

propositions.name: viscosity_could_grip_ether
propositions.statement: Unless there is a trace of something akin to viscosity, the ether cannot be got hold of by moving matter.
propositions.quote: unless there existed a trace of something akin to viscosity by which the medium could be got hold of

propositions.name: ether_could_be_carried_by_matter
propositions.statement: Ether in the immediate neighbourhood of moving matter might be more or less carried along by it.
propositions.quote: ether in the immediate neighbourhood of moving matter should sooner or later be more or less carried along by it

propositions.name: band_shift_measurable_to_hundredth
propositions.statement: A shift of the central band as small as the hundredth part of the width of a band could be observed.
propositions.quote: a shift of the central band of the system by so much as the hundredth part of the width of a band could be observed

propositions.name: gravitation_as_connexion_mode
propositions.statement: There may be an unknown kind of connexion between ether and matter concerned in gravitation, and a large mass must be used to display any effect on this.
propositions.quote: the unknown kind of connexion which is concerned in gravitation; and to display any effect on this, a large mass must be used.

propositions.name: motion_relative_to_ether_produces_effect
propositions.statement: Since a motion of the disks relative to the observer and the light causes no effect, the ether being stationary, a motion of the light and observer relative to the ether would produce an effect.
propositions.quote: a motion of the disks relatively to the observer and the light causes no effect, the ether being stationary, it follows that a motion of the light and observer would produce an effect

propositions.name: rotating_apparatus_should_show_reversible_shift
propositions.statement: If the whole apparatus and observer were mounted on a turntable and caused to rotate, a reversible shift of the bands should be seen.
propositions.quote: if, instead of spinning only the disks, the whole apparatus, lantern, optical frame, telescope, observer and all were mounted on a turntable and caused to rotate, a reversible shift of the bands should be seen.

propositions.name: aberrational_effect_accelerates_retards_beams
propositions.statement: The effect of rotating the apparatus would be of an aberrational kind, the opposite light beams being accelerated and retarded by the motion.
propositions.quote: The effect would be of an aberrational kind, the opposite light beams being accelerated and retarded by the motion appropriately.

propositions.name: ether_stationary_earth_rotation_shift
propositions.statement: If the ether is stationary near the earth, a single interference square would show a shift of more than one band width due to the earth's rotation.
propositions.quote: then a single interference square, 1 kilometre in the side, would show a shift of rather more than one band width, due to the earth’s rotation in these latitudes

propositions.name: earth_could_carry_ether_round
propositions.statement: The rotation of the earth might carry the ether round with it, which would allow a perceptible shift of the bands to be arranged for.
propositions.quote: by staking out mirrors at the corners of a field, it is arithmetically quite possible to arrange for a perceptible shift of the bands due to the rotation of the earth, if it carries ether round with it

propositions.name: connexion_sought_is_viscosity_like
propositions.statement: The connexion looked for between ether and matter is something of the nature of viscosity.
propositions.quote: The connexion looked for between ether and matter being something of the nature of viscosity, the space between the disks may be considered rather wide

propositions.name: matter_drags_ether_proportional_to_mass
propositions.statement: If matter conceivably drags the ether with it in proportion to its mass, an ordinary lump of matter can hardly be expected to shift the ether.
propositions.quote: If matter conceivably drags the ether with it in proportion to its mass, an ordinary lump of matter can hardly be expected to cope with the heart and to shift it

propositions.name: no_shift_from_magnetized_spinning_mass
propositions.statement: There was not a trace of shift when the iron mass was spinning, either with or without its magnetising current.
propositions.quote: there was not a trace of shift when the mass was spinning, either with or without its magnetising current.

propositions.name: temperature_inequality_causes_flicker
propositions.statement: If there was the slightest inequality of temperature in the air, it caused a slight flicker of the bands.
propositions.quote: unless the wire coil inside had been recently used and imperceptibly warmed by the current the air jet made very little difference, though if there was the slightest inequality of temperature it caused a slight flicker.

propositions.name: gas_density_distorts_bands
propositions.statement: A trace of coal gas distorted the bands, sending them waving through ellipses and contortions into invisibility.
propositions.quote: a whiff of coal gas, the merest trace, distorted the bands with agony — sent them waving through ellipses and contortions into invisibility, allowing them to re-appear as the gas diffused away.

propositions.name: bands_sensitive_to_fluctuating_density
propositions.statement: The bands were extremely sensitive to fluctuating density, and the flicker was traced to hot air from the carbon rheostat which regulated the driving current.
propositions.quote: They were manifestly extremely sensitive to fluctuating density, and hence we traced the previous flicker to hot air from the carbon rheostat which regulated the driving current.

propositions.name: flicker_caused_by_heat_convection_not_motion
propositions.statement: The flickering of the bands only occurred when the motor was used, and was plainly a heat convection effect, not an effect of starting or stopping the iron by hand.
propositions.quote: Starting and stopping the iron by hand did not cause the bands to flicker; they only flickered when the motor was used. It was plainly a heat convection effect.

propositions.name: no_shift_from_motion_or_magnetisation
propositions.statement: Neither motion nor magnetisation of the heavy iron mass caused the slightest real shift of the bands at the speed of 1000.
propositions.quote: never found either motion or magnetisation of the heavy iron mass cause the slightest real shift of the bands at the speed of 1000.

propositions.name: duration_of_motion_irrelevant
propositions.statement: The duration of continued spinning has nothing to do with whether a shift of the bands appears.
propositions.quote: We conclude that time has nothing to do with the matter.

propositions.name: air_effect_exists_distinct_from_ether_effect
propositions.statement: There is a true air effect, hitherto unobserved, whose detection would emphasise the truly negative character of the ether effect.
propositions.quote: This labour was undertaken not only because it was thought of interest to observe this hitherto unobserved small quantity, but also because its detection would emphasise the truly negative character of the ether effect.

propositions.name: density_gradation_affects_light_path
propositions.statement: A gradation of density in the air could cause a distinct effect on the beam of light passing between the disks.
propositions.quote: The gradation of density could therefore cause a distinct effect if the beam of light had an odd number of paths between the disks

propositions.name: centrifugal_force_causes_density_gradient
propositions.statement: The concertina effect and the residual irreversible shift may be caused by a gradation of density in the air between the disks, due to centrifugal force.
propositions.quote: A possible reason for the concertina effect, and for the slight residual irreversible shift sometimes observed, suggests itself in the gradation of density in the air between the disks, due to centrifugal force.

propositions.name: oscillatory_charge_radiates_into_ether
propositions.statement: An oscillatory charge certainly radiates wave motion into the ether.
propositions.quote: an oscillatory charge certainly radiates wave motion into the ether.

propositions.name: radiation_distinct_from_mechanical_disturbance
propositions.statement: Radiation is not a known kind of mechanical disturbance, but is concerned with the ether's electrical properties, and need not involve anything analogous to etherial viscosity.
propositions.quote: although radiation is not any known kind of mechanical disturbance, but is concerned with the ether's electrical properties, end need not necessarily involve anything analogous to etherial viscosity even in the neighbourhood of matter

propositions.name: electric_charge_could_grip_ether
propositions.statement: Electric charge, being as it were the connexion between ether and matter, might confer upon a material body some power of gripping and rotationally carrying forward the ether.
propositions.quote: electric charge, being as it were the connexion between ether and matter, might confer upon a material body some power of gripping and rotationally carrying forward the ether in a quasi-viscous manner.

propositions.name: air_has_breakdown_tension_limit
propositions.statement: Common air can stand only about as much electric tension as was concerned in the sparks between the disks.
propositions.quote: It may be taken that the difference of potential concerned was not far short of 40,000 volts., and that the electric tension was about as much as common air can stand.

propositions.name: no_effect_of_electrification_on_bands
propositions.statement: There was not the slightest difference in the shift of the bands whether the plates were electrified or not.
propositions.quote: There was a trace of irreversible shift when the disks were spinning, but its amount was quite independent of the direction of rotation, and there was not the slightest difference whether the plates were electrified or not.

propositions.name: no_field_confers_viscosity_on_ether
propositions.statement: Neither an electric nor a magnetic transverse field confers viscosity upon the ether, nor enables moving matter to grip and move it rotationally.
propositions.quote: neither an electric nor a magnetic transverse field confers viscosity upon the ether, nor enables moving matter to grip and move it rotationally.

propositions.name: irrotational_motion_undetectable_by_optics
propositions.statement: Irrotational motion of a single-valued kind could not be detected by interference or any other optical experiments, since such motion in no way affects the path or the speed of a ray.
propositions.quote: irrotational motion of a single-valued kind could not be detected by interference or any other optical experiments, since such motion in no way effects either the path or the speed of a ray

propositions.name: magnetic_field_no_grip_on_ether
propositions.statement: The conveyance of a magnetic field by moving matter confers no power of gripping the ether.
propositions.quote: it has now been shown that the conveyance of a magnetic field by moving matter confers; no power of gripping the ether

propositions.name: rotation_produces_centrifugal_force_on_observer
propositions.statement: Rotation of the apparatus at speed produces a centrifugal force that would change the observer's weight and its direction.
propositions.quote: at 30 revolutions a minute the observer’s weight, at a metre and a half from the centre, would be half as much again, and would be inclined at 45° to the vertical.

propositions.name: light_is_wave_motion
propositions.statement: Light consists of waves that travel through the medium and may be tilted, however reflected and refracted.
propositions.quote: however reflected and refracted they may be, is independent of the motion (no matter how the waves may be tilted)

propositions.name: glass_warping_from_heat_or_pressure
propositions.statement: Warmth or air pressure can cause a slight warping of the glass windows, producing an obscure influence on the bands.
propositions.quote: The residual trouble appeared possibly due to an obscure influence on the glass windows of the drum, possibly a slight warping due to warmth or air pressure

propositions.name: torque_can_mimic_reversible_effect
propositions.statement: Any torque effect, being of a reversible character, might easily be mistaken for the kind of result that was being looked for.
propositions.quote: Any torque effect, however minute, being of a reversible character, was peculiarly dangerous, for it might easily have been mistaken for a result of the kind that was being looked for.

propositions.name: retardation_of_path_causes_band_shift
propositions.statement: A retardation of the optical path due to gradation of density causes an irreversible shift of the band.
propositions.quote: there was on the whole a centimetre length of path uncompensated by a laterally inverted portion elsewhere, the corresponding retardation due to gradation of density would be a millionth of a centimetre, causing an irreversible shift
